description: Depuratori pubblici is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gaia.arpa.veneto.it. Location of public purifiers (urban waste water treatment plants) and IMHOFF tanks in Veneto, active and discontinued. The data are updated in real time by the Provinces and the Provincial Departments of ARPAV. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Public purifiers" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include IMHOFF, depuratori. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
